pages.text: Glowing Powder, Glowing Ingots, and Glowing Gems are stable mana-infused crafting materials used throughout Trinkets.$(br2)A quiet magical energy radiates from each one.$(br2)Keep their recipes nearby: many later items build from these materials.

Spark Powder is a powerful, unstable crafting material used in items such as the Arcing Orb.$(br2)Its mana crackles with a violent energy.$(br2)Craft it from Mana Reagent once you are ready to work with it.
